verdict.rationale: CSC is an entity-management and registered-agent SaaS platform with automated features: compliance calendar events, email alerts, SOP routing preferences, AI document routing and guided document workflows. A buyer could fairly ask whether those automations can be versioned and rolled back, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents version history, change review, or rollback for automations or workflow configurations. The routing and workflow features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.
